environment.description: Container deployed on GKE Autopilot cluster with Pod Security Standards enforced at 'restricted' profile. The pod spec includes securityContext with readOnlyRootFilesystem: true. No emptyDir, hostPath, or tmpfs volumeMounts are declared in the pod manifest. The container's ephemeral storage is entirely immutable at runtime. Note: the in-memory history slice still grows unboundedly (potential OOM), and the /debug/credentials endpoint remains routable within the cluster mesh — Istio AuthorizationPolicy only restricts external ingress at the gateway level, not east-west pod-to-pod traffic on port 8080.

config.volumes: none declared - no emptyDir, no hostPath, no tmpfs
config.network: Istio mesh, AuthorizationPolicy on ingress gateway only
config.note: memory leak in history slice persists, /debug/credentials reachable pod-to-pod
